Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve

Class SwerveSpeeds

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.ChassisSpeeds
frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable, edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable, edu.wpi.first.util.WPISerializable
public class SwerveSpeeds extends edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.ChassisSpeeds implements edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable
A ChassisSpeeds that additionally remembers whether it is field-relative or robot-relative, so speeds can be passed around and converted between the two frames without the caller needing to track that separately. This is the type Swerve.drive(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds) and SwerveController pass speeds around as throughout the swerve subsystem.
